decks.notes: The deck focuses on utilizing powerful control spells and disruption to control the game, while also taking advantage of powerful artifacts like The One Ring to gain an advantage. This deck focuses on using a toolbox of creatures to assemble a powerful combo that can win the game quickly. By tutoring for specific creatures with cards like Chord of Calling and Urza's Saga, the deck can find the right pieces to create an overwhelming board state. Cards like Nadu, Winged Wisdom and Springheart Nantuko provide powerful synergies that can be exploited to close out the game. The inclusion of cards like Arboreal Grazer and Wall of Roots help ramp up mana to cast the combo pieces quickly. Overall, the deck aims to efficiently assemble its combo and overwhelm the opponent.
